scope: Assistant-authored synthetic engineering dataset; source-family disjoint holdout, not independent human evaluation
selection_rule: Use development only for recall comparisons; old v2 questions are exposed regression. Freeze configurations before validation. Keep ranking and generation unchanged.
limitations: All new questions are assistant-authored. Source-family holdout is synthetic rather than independent human data. Negatives measure returned candidates, not answer/refusal correctness. Role/visibility questions test business knowledge, runtime ACLs need integration tests. Single serial timing is not production latency.
